1734// Helper class to handle MaterialAttribute changes on the compiler stack
1735class FScopedMaterialCompilerAttribute
1736{
1737public:
1738 FScopedMaterialCompilerAttribute(FMaterialCompiler* InCompiler, const FGuid& InAttributeID)
1739 : Compiler(InCompiler)
1740 , AttributeID(InAttributeID)
1741 {
1742 check(Compiler);
1743 Compiler->PushMaterialAttribute(AttributeID);
1744 }
1745
1746 ~FScopedMaterialCompilerAttribute()
1747 {
1748 verify(AttributeID == Compiler->PopMaterialAttribute());
1749 }
1750
1751private:
1752 FMaterialCompiler* Compiler;
1753 FGuid AttributeID;
1754};
